title: Delivery Claims Settlement Schedule: Reshipments and Refunds by Claim Type
content:
Refund Operations schedule for Delivery Claims: how an approved claim of each type is made whole by default, what a reshipment carries, where and how fast a refund is paid, how the claimed value is measured and the highest compensation an agent may approve on one claim.

## Resolution terms

| Claim type | Made whole by default by | Customer may take a refund instead of a reshipment | When the same SKU and size cannot be reshipped | Claim type refunds the order's shipping fee and surcharge with its merchandise |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Late Delivery Claim | shipping fee refund | no | not applicable | yes |
| Delivered Not Received Claim | reshipment | yes | merchandise refund | yes |
| Lost in Transit Claim | reshipment | yes | merchandise refund | yes |
| Damaged in Transit Claim | reshipment | yes | merchandise refund | no |
| Missing Item Claim | reshipment | yes | merchandise refund | no |
| Wrong Item Claim | reshipment | yes | merchandise refund | no |

## Reshipment and refund terms

| Claim type | Reshipment service | Reshipment shipping fee (USD) | What may be reshipped | Refunds paid to | Refund timing (business days from approval) | Highest compensation an agent may approve on one claim (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Late Delivery Claim | not applicable | 0.00 | not applicable | the order's original tenders | 3 | 1500.00 |
| Delivered Not Received Claim | Expedited 2-Day | 0.00 | the same SKU in the same size | the order's original tenders | 3 | 1500.00 |
| Lost in Transit Claim | Expedited 2-Day | 0.00 | the same SKU in the same size | the order's original tenders | 3 | 1500.00 |
| Damaged in Transit Claim | Expedited 2-Day | 0.00 | the same SKU in the same size | the order's original tenders | 3 | 1500.00 |
| Missing Item Claim | Expedited 2-Day | 0.00 | the same SKU in the same size | the order's original tenders | 3 | 1500.00 |
| Wrong Item Claim | Expedited 2-Day | 0.00 | the same SKU in the same size | the order's original tenders | 3 | 1500.00 |

## Claimed value

For every claim type the claimed value is the net merchandise paid plus tax: the merchandise paid on the claimed order lines (their booked amounts net of price adjustments and late promotions) together with those lines' share of the order's sales tax. A parcel-scope claim takes the whole order; a line-scope claim takes the claimed lines only.

## Points of reading

- A reshipment always travels by Expedited 2-Day at a shipping fee of 0.00 and carries the same SKU in the same size; any other item or size is not a reshipment.
- A compensation above 1500.00 USD on one claim is beyond what an agent may approve; exactly 1500.00 USD is within it.
- Hypothetical illustration of claimed value: a line-scope claim on one line booked at 80.00 USD with a 10.00 USD price adjustment, whose share of the order's sales tax is 5.60 USD, has a claimed value of 70.00 USD of merchandise plus 5.60 USD of tax, that is 75.60 USD.
